title: Wells Fargo upgrades US AI infrastructure stocks to neutral after chip rout
description: Wells Fargo upgraded its outlook on US AI infrastructure stocks to neutral from negative, citing improved valuations after a steep semiconductor sell-off. However, it warned that slowing AI investment and rising depreciation costs could pressure earnings in 2028.
